name: WhoisFreaks_DNSHistory
author: WhoisFreaks
description: Get the DNS records seen for a domain over time. 2 credits per page.

configurationItems.name: max_pages
configurationItems.description: Result pages to fetch per run (each page is billed); 1 to 20

configurationItems.name: dns_record_types
configurationItems.description: Record types to return: all, or a comma-separated list of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SOA, SPF, TXT (IP lookups always return PTR)
